companies.name: ナチュラル・ガス・サービシズ

relations.text: NGSが10-Kで、借入枠の幹事行(administrative agent)として挙げる
relations.text_en: NGS names Texas Capital Bank the administrative agent of its revolving credit facility

source.label: Natural Gas Services Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have a senior secured revolving credit agreement, as amended, or the Credit Facility, with Texas Capital Bank, National Association as administrative agent (the "Administrative Agent")

companies.name: アプライド・デジタル

relations.text: Applied Digitalが10-Kで、5,850万ドルのローン契約の相手として挙げる(2026年6月)
relations.text_en: Applied Digital signed a $58.5 million loan agreement with Texas Capital (June 2026)

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: On June 30, 2026, the Company entered into a Loan and Security Agreement (the "Texas Capital Loan Agreement") with Texas Capital Bank ("Texas Capital") and a related Promissory Note in favor of Texas Capital in the stated principal amount of $58.5 million

companies.name: クエスト・リソース
companies.sub: 廃棄物・リサイクル管理

relations.text: Quest Resourceが10-Kで、2026年3月のローン・セキュリティ契約の相手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Quest Resource entered a loan and security agreement with Texas Capital Bank (March 2026)

source.label: Quest Resource 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On March 12, 2026, we and certain of our domestic subsidiaries entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with Texas Capital Bank (the "TCB Loan Agreement").

companies.name: エプシロン・エナジー

relations.text: Epsilon Energyが10-Kで、2025年10月に組んだ借入枠の貸し手として挙げる
relations.text_en: Epsilon Energy names Texas Capital Bank a lender on its October 2025 credit facility

source.label: Epsilon Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company closed a new senior secured reserve based revolving credit facility on October 10, 2025 with Frost Bank as administrative agent and Frost Bank and Texas Capital Bank as lenders.

companies.name: プロス・ホールディングス

relations.text: PROSが10-Kで、2023年7月の借入契約の幹事行として挙げる
relations.text_en: PROS names Texas Capital Bank the administrative agent of its 2023 credit agreement

source.label: PROS Holdings 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: entered into a three-year secured credit agreement ("Credit Agreement") with the lenders from time to time party thereto and Texas Capital Bank as administrative agent for the lenders party thereto.

relations.text: Q2 Holdingsが10-Kで、5年の借入枠の相手としてWells Fargoと並べて挙げる
relations.text_en: Q2 Holdings names Texas Capital Bank in its five-year revolving credit agreement

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 29, 2024, the Company entered into a five-year secured Revolving Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC and Texas Capital Bank.

companies.name: ハラドール・エナジー

relations.text: Halladorが10-Kで、PNCに代わる新しい借入枠の相手として挙げる(2026年3月)
relations.text_en: Hallador replaced its PNC facility with one from Texas Capital Bank and Old National (March 2026)

source.label: Hallador Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On March 5, 2026, Hallador entered into a credit agreement with Texas Capital Bank and Old National Bank, among others, that replaces the Credit Agreement with PNC Bank
